purpose: Home's tent (and the empty-chat landings' and the covers' tent) is the logo's tent: the PixelLab sprite of tent-logo.json, pixel for pixel, mapped onto the riders' five day tones exactly as scripts/package-logo.py maps the logo. No redraw and no pixel edits.

owner.request: 2026-10-12 ~18:35, "the new tent in the logo also needs to be the new tent on teh home screen"
owner.exact: 2026-10-12 ~18:50, shown 96-px PixelLab redraws: "it needs to be the exact same pixel art"

replaces: The five-tone PixelLab Pro Flash big top, seed 26100201, of 2026-10-02 with its breathing loop (archive/2026-10-12-tent-before-logo/).

source.provenance: tent-logo.json (PixelLab generate-image-v2 Pro, job t3, image 2, seed 1012803)
source.size: 128x128 RGBA, alpha 0 or 255 only; the tent's pixels are (16, 13)-(116, 112), 101x100

tones: Each pixel with alpha 128 or more takes the nearest of clown-ride.json palette.day by the weighted distance 0.3 R, 0.59 G, 0.11 B (scripts/package-logo.py); the rest is transparent. The night tones are the app's runtime recolour of the day ramp.

crop.why: The packaged images are the source's 113x113 window from (10, 7): the tent with six clear pixels at its left, right and top and seven below, so it sits centred in the square the scene centres. Cropping removes only clear pixels; the packager refuses any frame with ink outside the window.

scene.rect: The 113-pixel square is 240.125 pt, centred in the 336 x 360 scene at (47.9375, 59.9375) (AgentLandTentArt.sceneRect)
scene.why: The tent's 101x100 pixels are 214.6 x 212.5 pt, about the old big top's 215.25 x 207.4 pt, centred on the scene's x 168 with its lowest pixel at y 285.2 (the big top's ground line was 285). The title, the rope rig, the orbit and the stage sizes are unchanged.

cleanup.rule: Tones 1-3 form the monochrome mark. The opaque silhouette closes each depth mask; no geometry is hand-painted.

doorway.method: Walk the darkest-tone 3x3 core from the seed inside the box, then grow one darkest-tone pixel. Only the dark opening between the tied-back curtains is cut; the curtains' outlines and shading, the valance and its centre scallop remain. The box is the opening's own extent: the walk stops at the curtains and the scallop on its own.

palette: clown-ride.json palette (day stored; night remapped without geometry changes)
